_note: Wand forms, from a beginner's 2-socket twig to a 10-socket archwand. Wands only: there are no staves. Crystals sit in all three zones and flow as one chain, hilt -> shaft -> tip. hilt and tip sockets come from the form (when that part is fitted); shaft sockets = min(shaft material sockets + shaftBonus, shaftMax).

forms.name: Twig
forms.text: A bare stick: shaft only, no hilt or tip. 2 crystals. With no hilt, your first crystal sets the base.

forms.name: Wand
forms.text: A hilt is bound on: 1 hilt socket plus up to 3 in the shaft. The hilt sets the base and where your charge comes from.

forms.name: Grafted wand
forms.text: Hilt, shaft and tip: up to 6 crystals and 1 side slot if the shaft has room. The tip decides what happens on exit and impact.

forms.name: Master wand
forms.text: A master's work: up to 8 crystals (2 hilt, 5 shaft, 1 tip) and every side slot the shaft can carry.

forms.name: Archwand
forms.text: The rarest wands: up to 10 crystals (2 hilt, 6 shaft, 2 tip) and every side slot the shaft can carry.
